## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Describe the relevant checks and their results.

## Visual evidence

- [ ] Current-head CI passed.
- [ ] I inspected the screenshots and recording.
- [ ] Compact screenshots AND video are embedded below using `scripts/pr-visual-evidence.py`.
- [ ] For UI changes, the evidence demonstrates the changed scenario and relevant outcomes. For documentation or tooling changes, it is labelled app smoke.

Follow [the evidence workflow](https://github.com/zigdanis/WhoGaveWhat/blob/master/docs/pr-evidence.md). Every PR requires both media types.
